facts.text: Do the robes of Saint Arthur have any magical properties? Dr. Uriah judged them not cursed but could not test them without Ingrid's witch powder, and wearing them had no notable effect.
Dr. Uriah wears the robes of Saint Arthur and carries the quarterstaff found with them. Brother Dirk says the robes are far too holy to wear and is deeply offended that Uriah wears them.
